compute.basis: The target is a single MAE cell from a grid search over 3 latent factors × 4 iteration counts × 4 learning rates × 4 regularization values × 4 folds = 768 BiasedMF runs on a small 100K-rating dataset; the Java CF4J framework is CPU-only and each run is seconds to a minute, so total command time is a few hours including setup and data download.

blockers: The linked repository may not contain the exact experiment configuration or may be outdated; the paper does not provide a runnable script for the full grid search.
The exact random seed and data split are not specified in the paper, so exact reproduction of the reported average may require reverse-engineering the code.
title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Matrix Factorization Models for Collaborative Filtering Recommender Systems
